# Vile

# Introduction

Viles are aggressive creatures found in Plains during the night. They are a stronger, undead variant of Bears.

## Behavior

Viles will avoid fire, they will run away if they get within 3 meters of a fire source. They will still attack players holding a Torch, but they will alter the attack direction at the last moment, making many attacks miss.
Viles consume Blueberries on the ground, but they are not tameable. They do not attack Bears despite being in two different enemy factions.

## Attacks and abilities

The Vile shares all of its animations with the Bear.

### Bite

Lunges forward to bite the player (20 Slash and 130 Pierce damage). This extends 4 meters in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 4 seconds when within 3 meters of a player.

### Claws

Stands on their hind legs, bounces forward a little, and slams down to attack (130 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack has an arched hitbox 5.5 meters long and 45 degrees across horizontally. It can be used every 4 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

### Swipe

This attack has two variations, each with its own 4-second cooldown: a swipe with the left claw and a swipe with the right claw (120 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack extends 5.5 meters out in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used within 5 meters of a player.

### Swipe combo

Chains both the left swipe and the right swipe together (60 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage each hit). This attack extends 5.5 meters out in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used within 5 meters of a player.

### Slam

Looks very similar to the claw attack, but remains stationary instead of bouncing forward and puts slightly more emphasis on their paws instead of claws (150 Blunt, 40 Tier 0 Chop and 40 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). Unlike the claw attack, this attack hits in a circular area with a radius of 2.5 meters. This can be used every 12 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

## Drops

• Item: Bear hide | 0 Star: 1

• Item: Bear meat | 0 Star: 2

## Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Plains during the nighttime | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very rare | Stars: No

## Note

• Bears and Viles regenerate slightly faster than most creatures, recovering full health over 50 minutes instead of 60.
